name: Blinn-Phong Shading Model
definition: Computes specular reflectance using the Blinn-Phong approximation with a cosine-power lobe.
summary: The Blinn-Phong Shading Model calculates voxel color using ambient, diffuse, and specular components, distinguishing itself from Phong by using a half-vector for specular highlights to improve performance and smoothness.
